director.finalPrompt:
[Audience Purpose]
Keen tiptoes past Zenny, removes the whole comb, proves the branch empty, and triggers Fuzzby’s wing-buzz pursuit handoff.

[Shot Sequence]
Shot 1: 0–2.5s
Visible cast: Keen @图5; Zenny @图3; Fuzzby @图4 only.
Camera: Cross-bank geography view: near-bank catapult, creek path, Zenny @图3’s leaf, far-tree honeycomb. No aerial action in this view.
Action: Keen @图5 at the near-bank empty catapult notices laughing Fuzzby @图4 and chooses the cross-bank route.
Performance: Keen @图5’s jaw closes; his eyes find the opening; he shifts from shocked stillness into a cautious tiptoe start.
Setting / light / materials: Warm morning daylight, soft contact shadows, empty catapult foreground-left, creek gap center, Zenny @图3 fixed on the far-bank leaf, Fuzzby @图4 small on the hanging comb.
End state: Keen @图5 starts moving upright on tiptoe; Zenny @图3 and Fuzzby @图4 remain in their established positions.
Keep identities and actions distinct.

Shot 2: 2.5–6.8s
Visible cast: Keen @图5; Zenny @图3; Fuzzby @图4 only.
Camera: Track the complete traversal from near bank to far-tree branch, proving Zenny @图3 clearance and whole-comb removal. No winged recovery in this view.
Cut to this view.
Action: Keen @图5 completes the cross-bank route past Zenny @图3’s original leaf with clear space, reaches the far-tree branch, and removes the whole honeycomb as one intact object.
Performance: Keen @图5 keeps upright balance, passes with clear space, pulls the intact comb free, and the branch/socket reads empty the instant the comb leaves.
Setting / light / materials: The creek, Zenny @图3’s leaf, and the far-tree branch stay fixed in space; the honeycomb remains one object in Keen @图5’s paws; no duplicate stays behind.
End state: The whole comb is in Keen @图5’s paws; Zenny @图3 remains untouched on her leaf; the branch/socket is visibly empty.
Keep identities and actions distinct.

Shot 3: 6.8–12s
Visible cast: Keen @图5; Fuzzby @图4 only.
Camera: Dedicated Fuzzby @图4 slip-and-hover view in the same far-tree geography. Hold the empty branch, Fuzzby @图4 buzzing in place, then following Keen @图5.
Cut to this view.
Action: Fuzzby @图4 slips a short distance from the lost perch, buzzes his wings to hold position, steadies himself, and starts following Keen @图5.
Performance: Fuzzby @图4 drops, catches himself with a fast irregular buzz, fixes on Keen @图5, and begins pursuit while Keen @图5 exits with the comb.
Setting / light / materials: The far-tree branch stays visibly empty; air above the creek opens for pursuit; the comb stays intact in Keen @图5’s grasp.
End state: Keen @图5 exits with the whole comb, Fuzzby @图4 is hovering and following, far-tree branch remains empty.
Hold: 0.5s — Hold the empty branch and Fuzzby catching himself long enough to prove the comb did not remain at the tree.
Keep identities and actions distinct.

@图1 is the first frame: opening composition/pose/state only; subsequent views follow the sequence.
@图2: incoming continuity evidence only. Carry explicitly surviving state at 0s; never override opening camera, canonical identity, character roles or later prop ownership.
@图3: Zenny identity/design only — round glasses; small dark nose; long eyelashes; rosy blush cheeks; smaller 12-inch bee proportions; one character, not sheet layout.
@图4: Fuzzby identity/design only — bulbous tan nose; round wire-frame spectacles; larger 14-inch bee proportions; one character, not sheet layout.
@图5: Keen identity/design only — aquamarine-blue fur; upright pale-white crown tuft; gold wrist cuffs with aquamarine gems; one character, not sheet layout.
@图6: prop:woodland-catapult design/materials/scale only; condition and ownership follow the sequence.
@图7: fixed geography/light only; never restore earlier character or movable-prop state.

[Continuity]
Preserve the approved look, fixed set geography, interaction axis and story time across cuts. Character and movable-prop positions follow the directed actions and end states. Geography: Near bank foreground-left holds the fired empty catapult and Keen’s starting position. The creek spans the center as the travel gap between banks. Zenny stays on her original far-bank leaf as the fixed witness point. Fuzzby stays on the single whole honeycomb at the far-tree branch. Keep the far-tree branch and hanging comb visible as the target. Do not compress the creek distance or shift landmarks.

[Audio]
No dialogue. Authorized generated sound only: woodland ambience and Fuzzby non-verbal wing-buzz/laugh SFX, with no spoken lines or vocal music. No watermark.

[AUDIO AND EXCLUSIONS]
No narration. No improvised or extra words. No extra voices. No subtitles, captions, text overlays, or watermark. No character redesign, no wardrobe changes, no duplicated cast members, and no dialogue articulation from nonspeakers. Seedance 2.5 must provide instrumental music, ambience and non-verbal SFX that support the scene; do not add sung lyrics, vocal music, narration, or any additional spoken words.

[Sound]

Carry the established ambience and musical energy into the pickup; do not restart the cue merely because this is a new generation.
Give the ending an intentional sound handoff. Avoid an unrequested closing crescendo followed by a fresh loud entrance; preserve a story-motivated accent when directed. Do not invent a fixed pause or stretch the performance.
